description: System-owned candidate, authority, verification, audit, and recovery architecture without Brain support.

mechanisms.description: Generate grounded candidate actions outside the model's authority path.
mechanisms.expected_role: move model work from unconstrained generation toward evaluation of grounded candidates

mechanisms.description: Constrain candidate actions to public, authorized, mechanically admissible operations.
mechanisms.expected_role: remove mechanically invalid or unauthorized action space before model judgment

mechanisms.description: Keep canonical state and hard invariants in deterministic system authority.
mechanisms.expected_role: prevent model cognition from becoming transaction truth

mechanisms.description: Use the model to semantically audit grounded candidates against the requested goal and evidence.
mechanisms.expected_role: catch semantic faults that deterministic checks cannot fully encode

mechanisms.description: Verify deterministic postconditions and invariants independently of the proposing/auditing model.
mechanisms.expected_role: prevent model self-certification and silent false success

mechanisms.description: Fence irreversible commit and reconcile uncertain outcomes through system-owned recovery state.
mechanisms.expected_role: separate semantic proposals from irreversible authority and duplicate-effect risk

interactions.reason: Determine whether semantic auditing creates value specifically when the model evaluates grounded system candidates.
Determine whether semantic auditing and deterministic verification are complementary or redundant.
